sanskrit_verse:
द्विपदामर्धमासं स्यात् पुंसां तद्द्विगुणं स्त्रियाः ।
दशाहं सर्वबीजानामेकाहं लोहवाससाम् ॥
transliteration: dvipadām ardhamāsaṃ syāt puṃsāṃ taddviguṇaṃ striyāḥ | daśāhaṃ sarvabījānām ekāhaṃ lohavāsasām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Half a month constitutes the period of restitution for bipedal beings; for men, it is that duration, and for women, twice that duration. Ten days apply to all seeds, and one day applies to iron vessels.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in natural order and cosmic rhythm, not human decree.
Causation aligns with embodied capacity and energetic resonance.
Capacity-based responsibility varies by ontological category and functional role.
Restoration logic operates through proportional temporal alignment with dharma-kala.
Consciousness alignment occurs when action harmonizes with inherent vibrational frequency.
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity = bipedal_being AND violation = minor_transgression THEN restitution_period = 15_days.
IF entity = man THEN restitution_period = base_duration.
IF entity = woman THEN restitution_period = 2 * base_duration.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving differential restorative timelines, the Supreme Court must recognize varnasrama-dharma categories as determinant of temporal responsibility cycles. Gender-specific restoration periods reflect intrinsic energetic distinctions, not social privilege. Material classifications inform proportional completion cycles based on subtle vibratory impact.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals that dharmic misalignment manifests sequentially through disrupted kala-vibhuti. The prescribed durations realign individual consciousness with universal rhythm without punitive intent. Each cycle corresponds to anupurvasah—causal purification precedes manifest correction. Responsibility is calibrated to ontological capacity rather than moral fault.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate time-bound consciousness alignment through mantra-diksha corresponding to violated domain.
Assign completion rituals aligned with elemental affinity of transgressor and object.
Restore energetic balance via yajna proportionate to disruption magnitude.
Reintegrate actor into community through vrata observance matching restorative timeline.
Verify alignment through spontaneous ahimsa-vakya manifestation post-cycle completion.
final_declaration: This law proceeds from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, wherein justice restores harmony without inflicting pain, and reality responds solely to awakened consciousness. Dharma stands re-established. Punishment has no place. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
